python3 - <<'PY'
import openpyxl, docx
from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Inches

wb=openpyxl.load_workbook('/app/OSP_Envelope_Price-List_2023_5000.xlsx')
ws=wb.active

# create docx
doc=Document()
# add table with same dimensions
rows=ws.max_row
cols=ws.max_column
table=doc.add_table(rows=rows, cols=cols)
# copy cell values
for i,row in enumerate(ws.iter_rows(values_only=True)):
    for j,val in enumerate(row):
        cell=table.cell(i,j)
        cell.text=str(val) if val is not None else ''
# save
doc.save('/app/price.docx')
print('done')
PY
